curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with why signals matter and who they bind, then the red light stop, right and left turns on red, red arrows and the warning about other states.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card that keeps right on red apart from left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on red lights, red arrows and turns on red.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach flashing red lights and arrows, steady and flashing yellow, and the flashing yellow arrow, with the contrasts between steady and flashing signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for steady versus flashing red, steady versus flashing yellow, and flashing red versus flashing yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps steady and flashing signals.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover green lights and arrows, dark signals, the red X, yellow X and green arrow lane signals, and the pedestrian hybrid beacon sequence.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the three lane signals and the beacon's double red versus flashing reds.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on green signals, dark signals, lane signals and the beacon.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why color and shape matter, the meaning of each sign color, and the octagon and triangle.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for regulatory versus warning colors, orange versus pink, and octagon versus triangle.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sign colors and the stop and yield shapes.
